packages.label: מַלְכוּת וְשֵׂכֶל תַּחְתּוֹן
packages.reason: All these nodes share the essential nature of tzimtzum (contraction/limitation): the lower intellect concentrates the vast upper light into a graspable form, just as the dark pupil of the eye (bat ayin) focuses a mountain into its scope, or the sha'ara be'igula (circular preambles) leads step-by-step to the target point. Malkhut = dalet = chokhmah tata'ah = shekhinah = the governing wisdom of each world that channels the higher intellect downward. The festival-related nodes (four cups, four species, four Mishna repetitions) are all bechina of the letter dalet (malkhut = dalet) because they each represent the four-faced malkhut in a specific holiday context. Shacharut = the dark of the eye = sekhel tachton = the quality of Abraham's shacharit-prayer. The sekhel elyon (banim/sons with settled da'at) is the mirror-counterpart and is grouped here because the Torah's entire argument about lower/upper intellect is a single conceptual domain of cognitive structure.
nodes: בשבועות הוא סדר המשנה, שהוא ארבע פעמים ביד כל אחד
הקדמות המסבבין עד שבאים אל המכון

merge_notes.reason: Bat/bat ayin (pupil of the eye) shares the essential nature of tzimtzum: the dark of the eye concentrates enormous objects (like a mountain) into a small visible impression. This is identical to sekhel tachton = malkhut's function of limiting/concentrating the upper sekhel so it can be grasped. Direct source support: Torah #30 lines 20-21.

merged_nodes: הקדמות המסבבין עד שבאים אל המכון
merge_notes.reason: Sha'ara be'igula (circular gate) = the roundabout preambles that circle toward the intended point. This is the teaching function of sekhel tachton: the teacher provides smaller preliminary ideas (hekdamot) that circle around the great sekhel elyon to make it accessible. Shares nature with hekdamot = sekhel tachton already in CC-1.

Banim (sons with settled da'at) = sekhel elyon. The Torah defines sekhel elyon and sekhel tachton as a unified domain — one is the concentrating lens, the other the light being concentrated. They form a single cognitive structure pair. Grouped with the lower intellect package because Torah #30's argument is precisely about this pair: how lower intellect (malkhut) enables access to upper intellect.

packages.label: הָרְגָלִים וּבִינָה לָעִתִּים
packages.label_en: The Pilgrimage Festivals and Knowing the Times
packages.reason: All nodes here share the essential nature of binah knowing/discerning the right times: the three pilgrimage festivals (regalim) ARE binah la'itim — the concentrated moments of the year where bina touches time. Chamra (donkey) = Yissachar = yodei bina la'itim — the same bina-knowing-times nature. 'Teshuvat hashanah' = shalosh regalim — the turning-point of the year through which the festivals are defined as days of judgment/teshuvah. All express the domain of divine time-consciousness that governs the lifting of malkhut to or-hapanim.

merge_notes.reason: Chamra = Yissachar (Yissachar chamor garem) = yodei bina la'itim. The donkey-quality of Yissachar IS the quality of knowing the times = binah la'itim = the regalim. The karna-de-chamra (horn of the donkey) is the vehicle for rebuke that lifts malkhut to the regalim. Chamra shares the essential nature of bina la'itim.

Teshuvat hashanah = shalosh regalim because the festivals are the turning-point of the year (teshuvat = returning/turning), which are days of judgment and teshuvah. They are structurally identical in nature to the regalim cluster.

packages.label: הַצַּדִּיק הַמּוֹכִיחַ וְהַתְּפִלּוֹת
packages.label_en: The Rebuking Tzaddik, the Nose, and the Prayers
packages.reason: All nodes share the essential nature of the tzaddik's discernment through the sense of smell: Mashiach = the nose that smells/senses the prayers, discerning who is worthy and who is not. Tzaddikim = Mashiach (they carry the same discerning function in each generation). The prayers (tefillot) = yirat Hashem = the spiritual 'scent' that Mashiach perceives. Karna = the rebuker's voice (qol hamokhi'ach) = qeren hashofar — the horn that amplifies the tzaddik's rebuke. Torah haqedoshah = 'pesel lekha' (solid, heavy Torah that sinks to the bottom) = the real Torah that the tzaddik teaches, as opposed to the light dross. All these are manifestations of the tzaddik's role: discerning, rebuking, and elevating.

merge_notes.reason: Prayers = 'Yirat Hashem hi tit'halal' (Proverbs 31:30). The tefillot ARE yirat Hashem — prayer is the external manifestation of divine fear. This dyad is grouped with the Mashiach/nose cluster because the Mashiach discerns the prayers precisely through their quality of yirat Hashem — he smells/knows whether genuine fear is present.

Karna (horn) = qol hamokhi'ach (the rebuker's voice) = qeren hashofar. These three are the same essential reality: the amplified, penetrating voice of the tzaddik who rebukes. The karna in the Talmudic riddle IS qol hamokhi'ach. Grouped with Mashiach/tzaddik because the rebuking voice IS the tzaddik's primary mode of spiritual action in this Torah.

Holy Torah = 'Pesel lekha' (Exodus 34:1) — the solid, weighty Torah that sinks to the bottom (as the Talmud notes: 'or that is precious in this world will be heavy/sunken in the next'). This contrasts with kafui vekal/pessolet. The holy Torah's essential nature is its solid, dense quality — what the tzaddik teaches and what distinguishes real from false Torah.

packages.label: אַרְבָּעָה בָנִים וְאַרְבַּע מַלְכֻיּוֹת
packages.label_en: The Four Sons and the Four Kingdoms of Holiness
packages.reason: All nodes share the essential structure of the four-type typology: wise, wicked, simple, and one who doesn't know how to ask. This quaternary structure is the same essential nature expressed in the patriarchal sons (Yitzchak/Yishmael/Yaakov/Esav), the four Haggadah sons, and the four kingdoms of holiness. The polarity is neutral because this package contains both good archetypes (Yitzchak=wise, Yaakov=simple) and evil/neutral ones (Esav=wicked, Yishmael=doesn't-know), making it a structural taxonomy rather than a purely good or evil domain.
packages.dominant_node: כנגד ארבעה בנים דברה תורה, אחד חכם ואחד רשע ואחד תם ואחד שאינו יודע לשאל
nodes: כנגד ארבעה בנים דברה תורה, אחד חכם ואחד רשע ואחד תם ואחד שאינו יודע לשאל

merge_notes.reason: Yitzchak = ben chakham (the wise son). The name Yitzchak relates to tzachok/simcha, hence 'ben chakham yesmach av' (Proverbs 10:1). Yitzchak IS the wise son archetype. Merged into four-sons package as one of the four.
Esav = the wicked son. Explicitly stated in the Torah text. Merged as one of the four archetypes.

Yishmael = the son who doesn't know to ask. The proof text explains that Yishmael did teshuvah, and his teshuvah category is that of one who doesn't know how to ask for forgiveness for unknown sins. Merged as one of the four archetypes.
Yaakov = ben tam (wholesome/simple son), as written: 'veYaakov ish tam' (Genesis 25:27). Merged as one of the four archetypes.

packages.label: תּוֹרוֹת אֲחֵרוֹת וּפְסִילִים
packages.reason: All nodes share the essential nature of spiritual falseness/dross: foreign toroth (the teachings of the sitra achra) ARE pesilim (idols), because they claim to be Torah but are hollow simulacra. Kafui vekal (floated/light matter) = pessolet (dross/waste) — this is the physical description of what false Torah is made of: it is light, it floats to the surface, it has no substance. This contrasts with the holy Torah which is heavy/solid (kafui = precious = heavy in future world). The evil audacity (azut de-sitra achra) from which foreign toroth emerge is their shared root.

merge_notes.reason: Kafui vekal (light/floated) = pessolet (dross/waste). The Talmudic principle is that 'or that is precious in this world will be sunken/heavy in the next; or that is light (kafui) in this world will float to the top in the next.' The pessolet of Torah = the kafui vekal = the false/alien toroth. Merged into the evil package because the dross IS the foreign toroth' essential substance.
